units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. An extreme wide establishing shot at eye level; the camera eases in from almost still on a slow level move, gathering pace gently and settling as it arrives. The night sky full of countless separate round points of warm gold light, each point small, round and distinct, spread evenly through an ink-blue sky, the points drifting apart at the slowest breath. The band of the galaxy reads as faint dim dust, low contrast, no glowing nebula and no bright clouds. The cloud deck below is an unlit dark rim, black, unlit, no lit clouds. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
